articles.summary: Introducing The Hackett Group's AI World Class Finance benchmarks. Our latest research quantifies how artificial intelligence is reshaping finance performance and reveals a growing gap between organizations that redesign work around AI and those that simply automate existing processes. Organizations pursuing process-led AI transformation are creating performance advantages of up to 75%. The new benchmarks show what's possible across critical finance processes. In order-to-cash, for example, AI World Class organizations can achieve 52%-59% lower process costs, 43% faster dispute resolution, and 85% fewer delinquent days. The message is clear: AI isn't creating a technology gap. It's creating a performance gap.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Establishes AI World Class Finance Benchmarks

articles.summary: New The Hackett Group® Solution Intelligence research finds that procurement, finance and HCM solution providers are moving beyond standalone AI features and embedding AI directly into enterprise workflows to help coordinate, execute and optimize work across processes. But the transition remains a work in progress 64% of providers are extending existing SaaS applications with embedded AI capabilities, while only 36% represent fully agentic, AI-native approaches, 74% report production deployment of basic AI agents, yet more advanced multi-agent orchestration capabilities largely remain in pilot or development stages, and 86% rely on APIs to connect with third-party AI models, highlighting the growing importance of integration, orchestration and data architecture. The findings point to a critical shift: realizing value from AI increasingly depends not on the number of features available, but on how effectively AI is integrated into end-to-end workflows, data and decision-making.
articles.title: AI Solution Providers Shift From AI Features to AI-Enabled Execution

articles.summary: The Hackett Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: HCKT), an ROI-led AI transformation firm, today announced findings from both its North America and European 2026 SG&A Cost Study and Scorecard, revealing that the next generation of profitable growth will be driven less by economic conditions and more by AI-enabled operating models. The average costs of selling, general and administrative (SG&A) functions climbed to their highest levels in five years across both regions, exposing a widening gap between organizations that are improving productivity through artificial intelligence (AI) and those relying on traditional cost-management approaches. This was against a background of stronger revenue growth and moderating inflation.
articles.title: The Hackett Group® Finds SG&A Costs Reach Five-Year Highs Across North America and Europe
